_comment: F9bomber ledger map-title aliases (scripts/import_f9_ledger.py). Keys are norm()-normalized F9 map titles; values are data/map-registry.json keys (the importer fails loudly on a target key missing from the registry). Evidence-based entries: 'quarry' -> vsrquarry2 proven by F9 r1175 colliding with our vsrquarry2 match 2026-05-04T03-45-41 at 1.00 roster identity (the community calls Quarry 2 plain 'Quarry'; no plain-quarry map exists in the VSR registry); 'aliendunes' -> st_dunes (ST: Patton's Proving Ground) proven by F9 r1235 colliding with our st_dunes match 2026-05-21T02-53-03 at 1.00 roster identity with agreeing winners; 'mortswasteland' -> vsrmortwasteland (MRT = Mortarion) proven by F9 r1301 colliding with our vsrmortwasteland match 2026-09-03T00-57-19 at 1.00 roster identity with agreeing winners. XMAS-*/Ground Zero have no registry entry -- unmapped titles carry map_key null and simply paint no map-page chip.
